class.name: NNBTLeaf
class.brief_description: Used for conditions and actions. Override [method NNBTTaskNodes.on_tick] to implement custom logic, and optionally add child considerations for scoring.
class.description: The leaf node is used for conditions and actions. You should define your own [method NNBTTaskNodes.on_tick] method where you do your logic. A leaf that does not override [method NNBTTaskNodes.on_tick] returns [code]Status.FAILURE[/code] and reports an error once per node instance that names the required [code]on_tick(delta: float) -> Status[/code] override. Example: [gdscript] func on_tick(delta: float) -> Status: return Status.SUCCESS [/gdscript] [method NNBTTaskNodes.on_tick] must return [code]SKIP[/code] (-2), [code]FAILURE[/code] (-1), [code]RUNNING[/code] (0) or [code]SUCCESS[/code] (1); any other return value logs an engine error and is treated as [code]FAILURE[/code]. A leaf can have direct [NNConsiderations] child nodes (such as [NNConsideration], [NNConsiderationGroup] or [NNCustomPropertyConsideration]); when the leaf is a direct child of an [NNBTScoreBasedPicker], those enabled considerations are aggregated according to [member NNBTNodes.evaluation_method] to produce the leaf's [member NNBTNodes.score].
